source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: setCalendarEvent validates the input, closes an open dialog, and only then changes event-route attributes. Callers that want the replacement visible must show it again; the changed location/visibility tests adopt that order. This is a presentation/lifecycle ordering change, not proof that every outstanding load is cancelled. Later callback, recurrence and readiness handling remain separate accepted phases.
title: Replacing an open Calendar event closes the dialog before changing its route
